question: Which NFA variant has the highest iron content, and what capacity did it keep at 1C in the rate test?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%Fe%' AND (text ILIKE '%x =%' OR text ILIKE '%0.%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%rate%') ORDER BY page, id LIMIT 80
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%rate capab%' OR text ILIKE '%Fe content%' OR text ILIKE '%iron content%' OR text ILIKE '%LiNi0.8%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE (page=10 AND line_no BETWEEN 18 AND 42) OR (page=2 AND line_no BETWEEN 105 AND 112) OR (page=11 AND line_no BETWEEN 36 AND 58) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, label, caption FROM tables; SELECT id, table_id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p5.T1' AND col_no IN (1,2) ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, table_id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p5.T1' ORDER BY row_no, col_no
